# InnovationLet Startups

> InnovationLet Startups is the funding, founders and growth desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on funding, founders, go-to-market and company operations,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Startups
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/startups/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Key pages

- Home / latest: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/startups/

- News sitemap: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/startups/news-sitemap.xml

## Coverage

- Funding: rounds, terms, valuations, and liquidation preferences.
- Founders: the people building companies, including the ones who did not raise.
- Growth: go-to-market, pricing, retention, and unit economics.
- Operations: hiring, culture, and the internal systems that scale.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Startups" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/startups/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

## Licensing

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
and a link to the canonical article.
